# Pixel Craft Studio

> Free online pixel art studio and pattern generator for Tapestry Crochet, DMC Cross-Stitch, Perler Beads, Alpha Keychains, and Diamond Painting.

## Overview
Pixel Craft Studio (https://www.pixel-craft-studio.com/) is a free, modern web application that converts images into craft grids and provides a full pixel art drawing studio. It runs entirely in the browser with no account creation, no subscriptions, no paywalls, and no watermarks.

## Dedicated Craft Studios & Direct Pages

### 1. DMC Cross-Stitch Pattern Maker (https://www.pixel-craft-studio.com/cross-stitch)
- Perceptual CIELAB Delta-E color quantization against the official DMC embroidery floss catalog (175+ colors).
- Generates high-contrast printable PDF charts with unique symbol keys, 10x10 major grid lines, and center starting arrows.
- Aida cloth sizing calculator (11ct, 14ct, 16ct, 18ct, 22ct, 28ct) with fabric cut margins and hoop preview.

### 2. Tapestry Crochet Pattern Generator (https://www.pixel-craft-studio.com/crochet)
- Converts any picture or custom drawing into a row-by-row written pattern with color-change stitch counts.
- Interactive progress tracker with checkboxes for each row and stitch.
- Physical gauge calculator supporting multiple yarn weights (worsted, DK, bulky) and stitch types (Single Crochet, Half Double Crochet, Waistcoat, C2C) to estimate physical blanket dimensions and yardage.

### 3. Intarsia & Fair Isle Knitting Chart Maker (https://www.pixel-craft-studio.com/knitting)
- Converts pictures or pixel art into realistic knitting charts with authentic non-square rectangular gauge ratios (stockinette 4:5 ratio) to eliminate vertical stretching.
- Tactile V-stitch loop texture simulation with yarn yardage calculator and needle sizing (US 2 to US 10).
- Row-by-row alternating Right Side (RS Knit) and Wrong Side (WS Purl) chart tracker.

### 4. Bead Loom & Peyote Stitch Pattern Maker (https://www.pixel-craft-studio.com/loom-beading)
- Converts pictures and custom pixel grids into precision bead loom and peyote stitch patterns for Miyuki Delica 11/0 cylinder glass beads.
- Cylindrical 3D glass bead texture simulation with specular reflection and thread hole preview.
- Sizing calculator for bead counts, 5g Delica tube quantities, warp thread counts (columns + 1) with tie-off cut lengths, and slide end clasp tube sizing (10mm to 35mm).

### 5. Alpha Pattern & Keychain Studio (https://www.pixel-craft-studio.com/alpha-keychain)
- Creates alpha friendship bracelet and keychain knotting patterns with realistic horizontal knot texture simulation.
- Calculates exact base / warp strings to cut (with clasp margins), total knotting floss yardage, and DMC skeins.
- Ribbon clamp hardware sizing (16mm, 20mm, 25mm, 30mm) for keychain attachments.

### 6. Perler & Fusible Bead Grid Maker (https://www.pixel-craft-studio.com/perler-beads)
- Quantizes artwork against standard Perler, Hama, and Artkal bead palettes with exact bead count breakdowns.
- Visual 29×29 interlocking pegboard simulation with physical inch/centimeter size estimates.

### 7. Diamond Painting Chart Maker (https://www.pixel-craft-studio.com/diamond-painting)
- Quantizes artwork into 2.5mm square drills matching DMC drill colors with complete drill count breakdowns.

### 8. Freehand Pixel Art Drawing Studio (https://www.pixel-craft-studio.com/pixel-art)
- Freehand pencil with Bresenham line smoothing (no skipped pixels on fast mouse/stylus drags).
- 4-way BFS flood fill paint bucket tool.
- Straight line and box/rectangle shape tools with 60fps live previews.
- Real-time vertical symmetry and mirror drawing mode.
- Curated retro palettes: PICO-8 (16 colors), GameBoy Classic (4 shades), Retro Arcade (16 colors), Pastel Dreams, DMC Floss, and Perler Beads.

### 9. Community Pattern Showcase & Individual Pattern Pages (https://www.pixel-craft-studio.com/gallery)
- Browse 32 stitch-calibrated patterns across all 8 crafts (Cross-Stitch, Perler Beads, Tapestry Crochet / C2C, Intarsia & Fair Isle Knitting, Bead Loom, Alpha Bracelets, Diamond Painting, and Pixel Art).
- Dedicated indexable landing pages (`/patterns/:slug`) for every pattern featuring finished physical dimensions, required Aida/pegboard/yarn materials, beginner tips, and 1-click loading into the interactive Studio canvas.

### 10. Interactive Thread & Bead Color Chart + CIELAB Hex Matcher (https://www.pixel-craft-studio.com/color-chart)
- **Hex-to-Thread & Bead Matcher** (https://www.pixel-craft-studio.com/color-chart): Pick or type any hex code to find the closest perceptual CIELAB Delta-E matches across DMC embroidery floss, Perler beads, and Miyuki Delica 11/0 seed beads.
- **DMC ↔ Anchor Floss Chart** (https://www.pixel-craft-studio.com/color-chart/dmc-to-anchor): Searchable 175+ shade reference with Anchor conversions, color family filters, lightness sorting, and personal stash tracking.
- **Perler ↔ Artkal ↔ Hama Chart** (https://www.pixel-craft-studio.com/color-chart/perler-bead-colors): Complete 36-color fusible bead cross-reference table mapping Perler codes to Artkal S-series and Hama Midi equivalents.
- **Miyuki Delica 11/0 Color Chart** (https://www.pixel-craft-studio.com/color-chart/miyuki-delica): 48 calibrated seed bead shades across Opaque, Matte, Metallic, Duracoat, Ceylon/Pearl, and Silver-Lined finishes with closest DMC thread matches.

### 11. Free Craft Calculators Suite (https://www.pixel-craft-studio.com/calculators)
- **Floss Skein & Cost Estimator** (https://www.pixel-craft-studio.com/calculators/floss-estimator): Calculates DMC embroidery floss yardage, meters, 8m skeins, and cost based on Aida fabric count and thread strands.
- **Bead Grams ↔ Count Converter** (https://www.pixel-craft-studio.com/calculators/bead-converter): Converts weight in grams to exact bead counts for Miyuki Delica 11/0, seed beads, and 5mm Perler/Hama beads with 29x29 pegboard counts.
- **C2C & Blanket Sizer** (https://www.pixel-craft-studio.com/calculators/c2c-blanket-size): Computes finished blanket dimensions in inches/cm and yarn yardage for corner-to-corner and graphgans.

### 12. Commercial & Pro Crafter Tools
- **Smart Background Remover & Subject Cutout**: In-browser CIELAB background segmentation, magic wand pockets, manual brush touch-up, edge defringing, and auto-trim so photos skip background stitches automatically.
- **Pattern Keeper & Markup R-XP Vector PDF Export**: Generates single-page selectable vector symbol charts with machine-parseable DMC legends for tablet stitching apps.
- **Hands-Free Voice Read-Aloud Companion**: Built-in Web Speech narration reading row directions and color stitch blocks aloud on manual step or auto-pace timer with screen WakeLock.
- **Smart Craft Supply Kit**: Calculates tailored fabric cut dimensions, hoop sizes, 29×29 pegboards, essential tools, and missing thread/bead quantities with 1-click Amazon kit lookup.
- **Etsy & Commercial Seller Kit**: 1-click generator for 4 high-res listing mockups (embroidery hoop flatlay, DMC palette swatch card, symbol chart quality closeup, size comparison table), Pattern Keeper digital vector PDF, 13 optimized Etsy tags, pre-written listing descriptions, and complete ZIP package download.
- **Projects Vault**: Multi-project local browser stash with visual thumbnail cards, continuous auto-save, and .pixelcraft backup import/export.
- **Decorative Border, Frame & Sampler Builder**: 8 symmetrical heirloom border styles (`classic-double`, `floral-vine`, `cottage-leaves`, `vintage-sampler`, `pixel-hearts`, `geometric-diamond`, `scalloped-lace`, `greek-key`) with expand/overlay placement and live canvas preview.
- **Staggered Peyote & Brick Seed Bead Grids + Word Charts**: True odd-column Peyote and odd-row Brick Miyuki Delica grid rendering & hit-testing, standard `(count)A` bottom-to-top Bead Word Charts, and automatic Miyuki Delica 11/0 `DB` shade code keys.
- **WIP Time Tracker, Stitch Speed & Progress Stats Card**: Persistent session journal, live running stitch stopwatch in the top header, stitches-per-hour & completion ETA analytics, and 1080×1350 PNG social progress stats cards.
- **Command Palette (`Ctrl+K`) & Before/After Photo Split Slider**: Searchable keyboard launcher across all 8 crafts, studio tools, and canvas actions, plus an interactive draggable divider slider comparing the original reference photo side-by-side with the live craft grid.
- **Live Community Pattern Showcase & Short Share Links (`/p/:id`)**: Publish public showcase entries or unlisted short `/p/:id` links with live likes, dynamic `1200×630` OpenGraph preview cards, clickable Creator Mini-Profiles, remix lineage attribution, community build tips, and 1-click "Open & Remix in Studio" powered by Supabase.
- **Open Cross-Stitch (`.OXS`) & Layered Vector (`.SVG`) Formats**: Bidirectional `.oxs` XML import/export compatible with Pattern Keeper, Markup R-XP, WinStitch, MacStitch, and FlossCross (including DMC floss codes, symbols, and backstitches), plus color-grouped `.svg` layers for Cricut and poster printing.
- **Cloud Projects Vault, Floss/Bead Stash & Progress Sync**: Optional email/password or Magic Link cloud sync uniting your Projects Vault, owned DMC/Perler stash, favorites, and WIP session journal across desktop, tablet, and mobile.
